plain_english_revision: The amendment expands the category of protected personal information on law enforcement officers' economic interest forms to include *all* public officials—not just law enforcement—making their private financial details exempt from public disclosure.
candidate_position_supported: Advances a policy that broadens the scope of personal information exemptions for *public officials* (beyond law enforcement) from public disclosure in economic interest statements.
